description: This file contains SwiftUI view extension methods for displaying and managing CronJob items within a user interface, including views for job details, context menus, run histories, and payload summaries.

methods.name: jobRow
methods.description: Constructs a SwiftUI view representing a summary row for a given CronJob, displaying its name, status, and various indicators.

methods.name: jobContextMenu
methods.description: Provides a context menu UI with actions such as run now, open transcript, enable/disable, edit, and delete for a specified CronJob.

methods.name: detailHeader
methods.description: Creates a detailed header view for a CronJob with controls for enabling, running, editing, and viewing transcripts.

methods.name: detailCard
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific CronJob, including schedule, description, agent, session, wake mode, last run statistics, and errors.

methods.name: runHistoryCard
methods.description: Shows the run history of a CronJob, including refresh controls and list of run entries.

methods.name: runRow
methods.description: Renders a single run log entry with status, timestamp, duration, and optional summary or error message.

methods.name: payloadSummary
methods.description: Provides a breakdown of the CronJob's payload, including system events and agent turn messages.
